META_DATA:
  Name: paged sparse GQA attention with sigmoid gate
  Describe: >-
    Per prefill query row, sparse GQA attention over its packed selected tokens of a paged BF16 KV cache, sigmoid-gated and written to out
  Source: KernelSchema@fa853fafd32a78ac496fbf71e615e34200eeeae3:kernel_wiki/aka-four-problems-20261019/qsa_prefill/aka_solution/solution.py::Model.forward
  Version: 2
CONTRACT:
  Algorithm_requirement:
    Constant:
      rows: {value: 4096, meaning: CP-local prefill query rows per call}
      query_heads: {value: 24, meaning: query attention heads per row}
      kv_heads: {value: 2, meaning: KV heads of the paged cache}
      group: {value: 12, meaning: query heads sharing one KV head}
      head_dim: {value: 256, meaning: 'elements of one query, key or value head vector'}
      selected_tokens: {value: 2051, meaning: selected-token columns packed per row}
      page_size: {value: 128, meaning: logical token slots per physical cache page}
      page_count: {value: 2626, meaning: physical pages of the cache pool}
      table_width: {value: 2054, meaning: logical page slots per request row of block_table}
    Input:
      q: {meaning: query tensor; one row per CP-local prefill token, shape: [{row: rows}, {query_head: query_heads}, {dim: head_dim}], dtype: bf16}
      k_cache:
        meaning: >-
          paged key cache; K view of interleaved K/V pages
        shape: [{page: page_count}, {page_token: page_size}, {kv_head: kv_heads}, {dim: head_dim}]
        dtype: bf16
        range: >-
          fixed strides [2157376,512,256,1]; finite only within pages block_table maps; other shared-storage elements arbitrary, possibly non-finite
      v_cache:
        meaning: >-
          paged value cache; V view at storage offset 65536
        shape: [{page: page_count}, {page_token: page_size}, {kv_head: kv_heads}, {dim: head_dim}]
        dtype: bf16
        range: >-
          shares shape, strides and storage with k_cache; same finiteness domain
      logical_indices:
        meaning: packed selected tokens per row plus valid_count
        shape: [{row: rows}, {packed_index: selected_tokens+1}]
        dtype: int32
        range: >-
          entry c >= 0 iff c < valid_count, else -1; valid_count in [2048,2051]; 512 distinct 4-token groups, then causal tail; all resolve via block_table
      block_table:
        meaning: logical-to-physical page map; -1 marks unmapped
        shape: [{request: 1}, {logical_page: table_width}]
        dtype: int32
        range: >-
          entries are page ids in [0,page_count) or -1; the single request row maps the 1024 logical pages of the 131072-token sequence, the rest are -1
      token_to_req: {meaning: request id owning each query row, shape: [{row: rows}], dtype: int32, range: [0, 0]}
      use_prefill_config: {meaning: framework flag ignored by the computation, shape: [], dtype: bool}
      output_gate: {meaning: gate logits; sigmoid scales the rounded result, shape: [{row: rows}, {query_head: query_heads}, {dim: head_dim}], dtype: bf16}
      out:
        meaning: optional destination, written in place; returned
        shape: [{row: rows}, {query_head: query_heads}, {dim: head_dim}]
        dtype: bf16
        nullable: true
        range: >-
          unrestricted on entry, including non-finite values; every element is overwritten by result
        default: None
    Output: {result: {meaning: 'gated attention result; returned, written to out', shape: [{row: rows}, {query_head: query_heads}, {dim: head_dim}], dtype: bf16}}
    Compute:
      - Name: Selection resolution
        Math: |
          For 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < selected_tokens, evaluated left to right:
            valid_count(r) = logical_indices[r, selected_tokens]; req(r) = token_to_req[r]
            resolved(r,c) = (logical_indices[r,c] >= 0) and (0 <= req(r) < 1)
              and (floor(logical_indices[r,c] / page_size) < table_width)
            If resolved(r,c), with logical_page = floor(logical_indices[r,c] / page_size):
              page_offset[r,c] = logical_indices[r,c] mod page_size
              physical_page[r,c] = block_table[req(r), logical_page]
              valid[r,c] = (c < valid_count(r)) and (0 <= physical_page[r,c] < page_count)
            Otherwise valid[r,c] = false and the resolved quantities are undefined
          In the declared domain every non-negative entry resolves, so valid[r,c] holds exactly for c < valid_count(r).
        Symbol:
          valid: {meaning: 'token (r,c) contributes to attention of row r', shape: [{row: rows}, {sel: selected_tokens}], dtype: not_applicable}
          physical_page: {meaning: 'integer physical page resolved for token (r,c)', shape: [{row: rows}, {sel: selected_tokens}], dtype: not_applicable}
          page_offset: {meaning: 'integer slot of token (r,c) within its page', shape: [{row: rows}, {sel: selected_tokens}], dtype: not_applicable}
      - Name: Attention scores
        Math: |
          Query head h decomposes uniquely as h = v*group + g with 0 <= v < kv_heads
          and 0 <= g < group, so head h shares the K/v of KV head v. With
          scale = head_dim^(-0.5) = 0.0625, for every (r,c) where valid[r,c] holds:
            s(r,v,g,c) = scale * sum_{d=0}^{head_dim-1} q[r, v*group+g, d]
              * k_cache[physical_page[r,c], page_offset[r,c], v, d]
          FP32 arithmetic over exact bf16 input values; s is undefined where
          valid[r,c] is false and takes no part in any reduction below.
        Symbol: {s: {meaning: 'scaled query-key score for (r,v,g) over token c', shape: [{row: rows}, {kv_head: kv_heads}, {group_head: group}, {sel: selected_tokens}], dtype: fp32}}
      - Name: Softmax over selected tokens
        Math: |
          For each (r,v,g):
            If some c has valid[r,c]:
              m = max_{c: valid[r,c]} s(r,v,g,c)
              z = sum_{c: valid[r,c]} exp(s(r,v,g,c) - m)
              p(r,v,g,c) = exp(s(r,v,g,c) - m) / z where valid[r,c], else 0
            Otherwise:
              p(r,v,g,c) = 0 for 0 <= c < selected_tokens
          In the declared domain valid_count >= 2048, so the empty branch is
          defined for completeness only.
        Symbol: {p: {meaning: 'attention probability of token c for (r,v,g)', shape: 'ref:s.shape', dtype: fp32}}
      - Name: Value aggregation
        Math: |
          For 0 <= r < rows, 0 <= h < query_heads, 0 <= d < head_dim, with
          v = floor(h / group) and g = h mod group:
            o(r,h,d) = sum_{c: valid[r,c]} p(r,v,g,c)
              * v_cache[physical_page[r,c], page_offset[r,c], v, d]
          FP32 accumulation; an empty valid set gives o(r,h,d) = 0.
        Symbol: {o: {meaning: 'attention output of (r,h,d) before gating', shape: [{row: rows}, {query_head: query_heads}, {dim: head_dim}], dtype: fp32}}
      - Name: Gated output rounding
        Math: |
          sigmoid(x) = 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
          result[r,h,d] = bf16( bf16(o(r,h,d)) * sigmoid(output_gate[r,h,d]) )
          for 0 <= r < rows, 0 <= h < query_heads, 0 <= d < head_dim.
          The inner bf16 rounding is a required intermediate rounding point:
          the gate product is formed from the rounded attention value, not
          from the unrounded o.
      - Name: Write-back and side effects
        Math: |
          None denotes Python None. If input out is None, result is delivered
          in a newly allocated tensor with the shape and dtype of q, and that
          tensor is returned; otherwise result overwrites every element of the
          provided out in place and the same tensor object is returned, so
          output result is visible both as the return value and as the
          post-call contents of input out. No other input is modified, and this
          includes the k_cache/v_cache storage elements that the computation
          does not select. use_prefill_config takes no part in the mathematics
          above.
    Golden_reference:
      Source: KernelSchema@fa853fafd32a78ac496fbf71e615e34200eeeae3:kernel_wiki/aka-four-problems-20261019/qsa_prefill/reference.py::Model.forward
      Tolerance:
        result: >-
          abs(candidate-reference) <= 3.2e-05 + 0.02*abs(candidate); float64; all elements; non-finite fails
  Hardware_specification:
    Device:
    Architecture:
    Execution:
      sm: >-
        Streaming multiprocessor; the device-level execution site on which CTAs reside and execute, owning the SMEM and TMEM pools from which resident CTAs draw their allocations
      cta: >-
        Thread block; a CTA resides on one SM, is composed of warps, and holds private SMEM and TMEM allocations drawn from that SM's pools
      warpgroup: >-
        Four consecutive warps (128 threads) of one CTA cooperating as a single role group
      warp: >-
        32 threads of one CTA executing as one lane group; the fixed source's specialized role workers and its shuffle and per-warp scan operations are warp-granular
      thread: >-
        Single hardware thread (lane) of a warp; the fixed source distributes per-element vectorized loads, hash updates and stores across threads
    Feature:
      mechanism: null
    Stack:
      Language:
      Toolchain:
    Wiki:

      Sota:
        Kernel:

      Profile:

  Math_reshape:
    Thesis:
    Rewrite:
      - Name:
        Math:
  Work_schedule:
    Thesis:
    Step:
      MAIN:
        Describe:
        Decomposition:
          Partition: {dimension: {meaning: null, size: null, tile: null}}
          Target:
            Single_tile: {output: {meaning: null, shape: null, dtype: null}}
        Mapping:
          Worker: {unit: null, unit_count: null}
          Worker_count:
        Schedule:
          Worktile_order: [{by: dimension, direction: null}]
          Worker_assignment:
            Refill:
            Exit:
    Flow:
      Launch: [{step: [MAIN]}]
  Tile_pipeline:

          MAIN:
            Info:
              Describe:

                compute: {output: {execution_mode: null, describe: null}}
